title: 哥達基線隧道
summary: 沿 24 個判讀步驟研究阿爾卑斯基線鐵路的路線、地質、施工物流、防水與鐵路系統整合；以可查證的證據代替想像中的挖掘配方。
summaryEn: Study alignment, geology, construction logistics, waterproofing and railway integration of an Alpine base tunnel through 24 evidence-led exercises.
scope: 以公開一次資料為背景的原創工程判讀課程；每步在紙上或數位示意模型中完成。自設數值、構形與工序不得當成原工程的設計、施工、設備操作或驗收程序。
scopeEn: Original engineering interpretation exercises grounded in public primary sources. Complete each step on paper or in a schematic digital model. Invented values, geometry and sequences are not the original project’s design, construction, operating or acceptance procedures.

stages.title: 路線、地質與不確定性
stages.description: 以六個相互銜接的練習完成「路線、地質與不確定性」，保留假設、圖示與判讀證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Complete six connected exercises on alignment, geology and uncertainty, retaining assumptions, diagrams and evidence.

steps.title: 把基線路線放回鐵路網
steps.titleEn: Place the base alignment in its network
steps.objective: 理解隧道長度以外的運輸目的。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand the transport purpose beyond tunnel length.
steps.instruction: 1. 畫跨山舊線與概念基線；2. 分列坡度、距離及連接路段；3. 指出一個仍可能限制全線容量的外部瓶頸。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Sketch the mountain route and conceptual base route; 2. separate gradient, distance and connecting sections; 3. identify an external bottleneck that could still limit capacity.
steps.observation: 隧道本身能力提高不會自動消除連接鐵路的瓶頸。
steps.observationEn: Improved tunnel capability does not automatically remove bottlenecks on connecting railways.
steps.failure: 只要隧道更長就一定使整條運輸走廊更有效率。
steps.failureEn: A longer tunnel necessarily makes the entire transport corridor more efficient.
steps.check: 繳交含兩端連接線的需求圖。
steps.checkEn: Provide a requirements map including both connecting routes.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 基線路線以較低高程穿越山體，坡度及路線條件影響列車牽引與運輸安排。
knowledge.textEn: A base route crosses at a lower elevation; gradients and alignment affect traction and transport planning.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 官方長度及運輸背景是比較起點，不能直接用來計算今天的班表能力。
knowledge.textEn: Official length and transport context begin the comparison but do not directly determine present timetable capacity.

quiz.question: 審查「把基線路線放回鐵路網」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Place the base alignment in its network”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 隧道本身能力提高不會自動消除連接鐵路的瓶頸。
只要隧道更長就一定使整條運輸走廊更有效率。
增加一段隧道的能力就保證所有連接路段同步增加能力。
optionsEn: Improved tunnel capability does not automatically remove bottlenecks on connecting railways.
A longer tunnel necessarily makes the entire transport corridor more efficient.
Increasing one tunnel’s capacity guarantees matching gains on all connecting routes.
quiz.explanation: 基線路線以較低高程穿越山體，坡度及路線條件影響列車牽引與運輸安排。 官方長度及運輸背景是比較起點，不能直接用來計算今天的班表能力。
quiz.explanationEn: A base route crosses at a lower elevation; gradients and alignment affect traction and transport planning. Official length and transport context begin the comparison but do not directly determine present timetable capacity.

steps.title: 分開雙管與連通設施
steps.titleEn: Separate running tubes and connections
steps.objective: 辨認列車路徑與橫向連通功能。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish train paths from transverse connections.
steps.instruction: 1. 畫兩條單線主隧道；2. 用不同符號標示橫坑及多功能區；3. 分開列車通道與人員通行的概念圖例。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Draw two single-track running tubes; 2. mark cross-passages and multifunction areas with different symbols; 3. separate train paths from conceptual pedestrian connections.
steps.observation: 兩條主隧道與橫坑具有不同功能，不能都視為可行車路線。
steps.observationEn: Running tubes and cross-passages have different functions and are not all train routes.
steps.failure: 圖上只要連通就能讓列車任意從一管換到另一管。
steps.failureEn: Any connection drawn between tubes permits trains to change tubes there.
steps.check: 提供至少三種連通功能的圖例。
steps.checkEn: Provide a legend distinguishing at least three connection functions.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 交通路徑、設備空間與逃生連通各有不同幾何及系統需求。
knowledge.textEn: Traffic paths, equipment spaces and escape connections have different geometric and system requirements.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 示意圖的連線不等於具備軌道、控制或可使用狀態。
knowledge.textEn: A connecting line in a schematic does not establish track, control or availability.

quiz.question: 審查「分開雙管與連通設施」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Separate running tubes and connections”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 圖上只要連通就能讓列車任意從一管換到另一管。
兩條主隧道與橫坑具有不同功能，不能都視為可行車路線。
所有橫坑都具有列車軌道及轉轍功能。
optionsEn: Any connection drawn between tubes permits trains to change tubes there.
Running tubes and cross-passages have different functions and are not all train routes.
Every cross-passage contains tracks and train-switching functions.
quiz.explanation: 交通路徑、設備空間與逃生連通各有不同幾何及系統需求。 示意圖的連線不等於具備軌道、控制或可使用狀態。
quiz.explanationEn: Traffic paths, equipment spaces and escape connections have different geometric and system requirements. A connecting line in a schematic does not establish track, control or availability.

steps.title: 建立地質預測與實證兩欄
steps.titleEn: Separate predicted geology from observations
steps.objective: 把地質模型當成需持續更新的假說。
steps.objectiveEn: Treat the geological model as a hypothesis requiring updates.
steps.instruction: 1. 畫含三種自設岩性區的縱斷面；2. 另列鑽孔與掌子面觀察欄；3. 將未驗證區段以虛線保留。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Draw a longitudinal section with three hypothetical rock zones; 2. separate borehole and face observations; 3. keep unverified sections dashed.
steps.observation: 地質預測必須隨新觀察更新，不能等同沿線已完全確認。
steps.observationEn: Geological predictions need updating with observations and do not establish complete route knowledge.
steps.failure: 已有一張縱斷面就表示兩個鑽孔之間的岩體全部已證實。
steps.failureEn: One section drawing verifies every rock volume between two boreholes.
steps.check: 提交預測、觀察與信心水準分開的剖面。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section separating predictions, observations and confidence.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 鑽孔只直接觀察有限空間，向外延伸的解釋具有不確定性。
knowledge.textEn: Boreholes directly sample limited space; extrapolated interpretations carry uncertainty.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 工程判讀重點是預測與實際差異如何影響模型，而非把地層畫得整齊。
knowledge.textEn: Engineering interpretation asks how prediction–observation differences affect the model, not how tidy the strata look.

quiz.question: 審查「建立地質預測與實證兩欄」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Separate predicted geology from observations”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 已有一張縱斷面就表示兩個鑽孔之間的岩體全部已證實。
鑽孔間的地層圖是直接觀察全部地下空間的紀錄。
地質預測必須隨新觀察更新，不能等同沿線已完全確認。
optionsEn: One section drawing verifies every rock volume between two boreholes.
A section between boreholes directly records the entire underground volume.
Geological predictions need updating with observations and do not establish complete route knowledge.
quiz.explanation: 鑽孔只直接觀察有限空間，向外延伸的解釋具有不確定性。 工程判讀重點是預測與實際差異如何影響模型，而非把地層畫得整齊。
quiz.explanationEn: Boreholes directly sample limited space; extrapolated interpretations carry uncertainty. Engineering interpretation asks how prediction–observation differences affect the model, not how tidy the strata look.

steps.title: 解讀斷層與破碎帶
steps.titleEn: Interpret faults and fractured zones
steps.objective: 辨識岩石種類與岩體結構的不同。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish rock type from rock-mass structure.
steps.instruction: 1. 用同一岩性畫完整及節理密集兩模型；2. 標出節理方向與水的可能路徑；3. 比較需要補充的觀察資料。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Draw intact and heavily jointed examples of the same rock type; 2. mark joint directions and possible water paths; 3. compare required observations.
steps.observation: 相同岩石名稱可能對應不同節理、水文及變形條件。
steps.observationEn: The same rock name may conceal different jointing, groundwater and deformation conditions.
steps.failure: 只知道岩石硬度即可選定所有支護需求。
steps.failureEn: Rock hardness alone determines every support requirement.
steps.check: 繳交岩性、構造與含水條件的分欄表。
steps.checkEn: Provide separate fields for lithology, structure and groundwater.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 岩體行為不只由完整岩塊強度決定，也受不連續面與水影響。
knowledge.textEn: Rock-mass behavior depends on discontinuities and water as well as intact-rock strength.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 本步不提供支護尺寸或挖掘設定，而是建立需由地質證據回答的問題。
knowledge.textEn: This step gives no support dimensions or excavation settings; it defines questions requiring geological evidence.

quiz.question: 審查「解讀斷層與破碎帶」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Interpret faults and fractured zones”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 相同岩石名稱可能對應不同節理、水文及變形條件。
只知道岩石硬度即可選定所有支護需求。
完整岩塊的強度可以取代節理與地下水資料。
optionsEn: The same rock name may conceal different jointing, groundwater and deformation conditions.
Rock hardness alone determines every support requirement.
Intact-rock strength replaces joint and groundwater information.
quiz.explanation: 岩體行為不只由完整岩塊強度決定，也受不連續面與水影響。 本步不提供支護尺寸或挖掘設定，而是建立需由地質證據回答的問題。
quiz.explanationEn: Rock-mass behavior depends on discontinuities and water as well as intact-rock strength. This step gives no support dimensions or excavation settings; it defines questions requiring geological evidence.

steps.title: 辨認覆土、地應力與溫度
steps.titleEn: Distinguish cover, stress and temperature
steps.objective: 避免用單一深度數字概括地下條件。
steps.objectiveEn: Avoid reducing underground conditions to one depth number.
steps.instruction: 1. 在斷面分別標示地表及隧道標高；2. 畫假想覆土變化；3. 將應力、熱與地下水證據列成不同需求。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Mark surface and tunnel elevations separately; 2. draw hypothetical cover variation; 3. list separate stress, heat and groundwater evidence needs.
steps.observation: 覆土深度增加不等於所有位置具有同樣應力方向或水壓。
steps.observationEn: Greater cover does not imply identical stress directions or water pressures everywhere.
steps.failure: 地表到隧道的距離可以直接替代完整地應力與水文資料。
steps.failureEn: Surface-to-tunnel distance replaces complete stress and hydrogeological information.
steps.check: 提交三類環境條件及各自需量測的資料。
steps.checkEn: Submit three environmental conditions with their measurement needs.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 地形、構造歷史與岩體性質會使應力場偏離簡單垂直自重估算。
knowledge.textEn: Topography, tectonic history and rock properties can make stress fields differ from simple overburden estimates.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 熱、水與力學資料具有不同量測方法，不能因共用一張剖面就互相代替。
knowledge.textEn: Thermal, hydraulic and mechanical conditions require different observations despite sharing a section drawing.

quiz.question: 審查「辨認覆土、地應力與溫度」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Distinguish cover, stress and temperature”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 地表到隧道的距離可以直接替代完整地應力與水文資料。
覆土深度增加不等於所有位置具有同樣應力方向或水壓。
熱環境與水壓可從覆土深度唯一決定。
optionsEn: Surface-to-tunnel distance replaces complete stress and hydrogeological information.
Greater cover does not imply identical stress directions or water pressures everywhere.
Cover depth uniquely determines temperature and water pressure.
quiz.explanation: 地形、構造歷史與岩體性質會使應力場偏離簡單垂直自重估算。 熱、水與力學資料具有不同量測方法，不能因共用一張剖面就互相代替。
quiz.explanationEn: Topography, tectonic history and rock properties can make stress fields differ from simple overburden estimates. Thermal, hydraulic and mechanical conditions require different observations despite sharing a section drawing.

steps.title: 制定勘察更新的決策紀錄
steps.titleEn: Create an investigation-update decision record
steps.objective: 讓新地質證據影響後續模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Make new geological evidence propagate into downstream models.
steps.instruction: 1. 設定一個與預測不同的假想觀察；2. 列出受影響的支護、物流與防水問題；3. 標記哪些結論需重做而哪些仍有效。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Introduce a hypothetical observation inconsistent with prediction; 2. list affected support, logistics and waterproofing questions; 3. mark conclusions needing revision and those still valid.
steps.observation: 新證據的價值在修正相依判斷，不能只新增一張地質照片。
steps.observationEn: New evidence should revise dependent judgments rather than merely add a geological photograph.
steps.failure: 把差異記錄存檔後即可繼續沿用全部舊假設。
steps.failureEn: Filing a discrepancy permits all old assumptions to remain unchanged.
steps.check: 繳交一份有上游證據及下游影響的變更單。
steps.checkEn: Provide a change record linking upstream evidence to downstream impacts.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 觀測與決策之間需要明確連結，否則資料很多也無法降低模型風險。
knowledge.textEn: Observations need explicit links to decisions; more data alone do not reduce modeling risk.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 未知條件可導致暫停判斷與補資料，這是工程品質控制的一部分。
knowledge.textEn: Unknown conditions can require pausing a judgment and gathering evidence as part of quality control.

quiz.question: 審查「制定勘察更新的決策紀錄」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Create an investigation-update decision record”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 把差異記錄存檔後即可繼續沿用全部舊假設。
地質模型一旦發布就不應因新觀察而修改。
新證據的價值在修正相依判斷，不能只新增一張地質照片。
optionsEn: Filing a discrepancy permits all old assumptions to remain unchanged.
A published geological model should never change after new observations.
New evidence should revise dependent judgments rather than merely add a geological photograph.
quiz.explanation: 觀測與決策之間需要明確連結，否則資料很多也無法降低模型風險。 未知條件可導致暫停判斷與補資料，這是工程品質控制的一部分。
quiz.explanationEn: Observations need explicit links to decisions; more data alone do not reduce modeling risk. Unknown conditions can require pausing a judgment and gathering evidence as part of quality control.
